# F1 track QA fixtures (synthetic)

Generated by `tools/track/gen_qa_clips.py`:

| Folder | Motion |
|--------|--------|
| `move_lr/` | Subject left → right |
| `approach/` | Subject grows (toward camera) |
| `occlude/` | Subject moves behind a vertical bar |

Each folder has `frame_XXX.png` + `centers.csv`. Optional MP4:

```bash
ffmpeg -y -framerate 15 -i move_lr/frame_%03d.png -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p move_lr.mp4
```
